pageIntro: Items to be discussed at an upcoming meeting. They appear automatically in the matching protocol under the chosen agenda item.
emptyDescription: Add a topic so it gets onto the agenda of the next meeting.
errorSave: The topic could not be saved.
errorDelete: The topic could not be deleted.
errorPostpone: The topic could not be postponed.
errorLoad: The topics could not be loaded.
createDescription: Enter a title and text, then choose the template, agenda item and date.
scheduleHelpNext: Appears in the next protocol of this template.
scheduleHelpMonth: Appears from this month on in the next protocol of this template.
boundHint: Listed in protocol {number}. To change the template, agenda item or date, postpone the topic.
frozenHint: Belongs to a closed protocol and can no longer be changed.
postponeDescription: When should “{title}” be back on the agenda?
noTemplates: There is no active protocol template yet.

editor.quickCreateDescription: Appears in this protocol under the chosen agenda item.
